How to Use
  1. Click table headers to sort. Numeric-looking columns sort numerically.
  2. Use global search for quick narrowing, or column filter for one specific field.
  3. Click a row to inspect all columns in the detail panel.
  4. For shuffle analysis, open ntt32_neon_plan.csv and focus on pair_shape / shuffle_need.
